verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API documents multi-location accounts: more locations can be created, sellers can review and edit location information in the Dashboard, and receipts can be customized per location. That covers multiple locations and some per-location settings. Nothing in the pack shows devices being assigned or managed per location, or reporting broken out by location. Missing for 10: per-location device/hardware management, per-location reporting, broader per-location settings beyond receipt text, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Newly created accounts only have this single location, but more locations can be created.
Sellers can review and edit location information in the Square Dashboard
A seller can customize the receipts issued for a location with two text fields.
